capturedFrom: the original T-SQL object, deployed unchanged to a scratch SQL Server database with the fixed case's rows
review: Captured from the source engine, not derived independently. A reviewer checks each case's expected values against its label at step 5 (second review). Values are canonical: n: number, s: text, b: bit, d: date, t: timestamp (microseconds), x: bytes (hex), ∅: NULL.

cases.label: [A01] percentage price at an exact half cent: 0.25 * 50 % = 0.125 rounds half away from zero to 0.13 (banker's rounding and truncation give 0.12)
[A02] deal priced at 19.95 competes with a percentage deal; lowest of all paths wins
[A03] pricing date at the maximum date 9999-12-31 equals the deal end date (BETWEEN is inclusive)
[A04] a negative discount amount would raise the price, so the < guard must reject it
[A05] StockGroup-scoped deal applies only through the StockItemStockGroups bridge; deal ids are non-contiguous
[A06] no customer row: BuyingGroupID and CustomerCategoryID stay NULL, so only the OR ... IS NULL deal legs match
[A07] three discount amounts through different deal legs (-1.00, 0.05, 3.15): the highest, 3.15, wins and gives 6.85
